column1: # Kotlin: classes (with and without a body, data classes), interfaces, enums,
# type aliases (listed as classes), objects (listed as variables: a singleton
# value), functions, and methods (listed as functions: a member is a function
# whose qualified name carries its class). An enum entry is listed as a
# function, the catch-all kind for a kind the query does not name. A call and
# an import are not definitions. A top-level val / const val is a constant and a
# top-level var a variable (a destructuring declaration and a property of a
# class are not). A name in backticks is listed without them. The methods of an
# anonymous object (object : T { ... }) are not definitions.
